policy: Reviewed, time-limited exceptions to the high-severity dependency audit gate. An exception records a deliberate decision that a specific advisory does not apply to how Wingman uses the package. It is not a way to silence a finding that has not been assessed. Every entry must carry a justification and an expiry; the check fails once an exception expires, so nothing here can quietly become permanent.

exceptions.title: React Router: RSC Mode CSRF Bypass Allows Action Execution Before 400 Response
exceptions.justification: The vulnerability is specific to React Router's RSC (React Server Components) mode, where an action can execute before a 400 response is returned. Wingman is an entirely client-rendered SPA: it mounts BrowserRouter in src/main.tsx, has no server-side rendering and no RSC entry point, and does not import any RSC or static-handler API from react-router. The vulnerable code path is therefore not reachable in this application.
exceptions.verification: Confirmed no RSC usage by searching src/ for RSC, createStaticHandler and renderToPipeableStream - no matches. Wingman renders via createRoot in src/main.tsx.
exceptions.remediationBlocked: No fixed release exists above the installed 7.18.1. npm's suggested remediation is a downgrade to react-router-dom 7.11.0, which would undo the deliberate 6.x -> 7.x upgrade applied in PR #115 and already patched for a BrowserRouter prop type change.
exceptions.reviewAction: Before expiry, re-check whether react-router has published a fixed 7.x release. If so, upgrade and delete this exception rather than extending it.
